class JingzhangDirectSunTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.samples = solar_samples(make_contract(grid_spacing_m=2.0))

    def test_contract_has_three_windows_and_forty_samples(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual("Asia/Shanghai", LOCATION["timezone"])
        self.assertEqual(3, len(make_contract()["time_windows"]))
        self.assertEqual(40, len(self.samples))
        self.assertTrue(all(item["elevation_deg"] > 0 for item in self.samples))

    def test_known_beijing_winter_noon_is_plausible(self) -> None:
        noon = next(item for item in self.samples if item["timestamp"].startswith("2026-12-21T12:15"))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(26.578676, noon["elevation_deg"], delta=0.01)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(180.637584, noon["azimuth_deg"], delta=0.01)

    def test_shadow_vector_analytic_and_directional(self) -> None:
        dx, dy = shadow_vector(10, 45, 180)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(0, dx, places=9)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(10, dy, places=9)
        east_dx, east_dy = shadow_vector(10, 45, 90)
        self.assertLess(east_dx, 0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(0, east_dy, places=9)
        west_dx, west_dy = shadow_vector(10, 45, 270)
        self.assertGreater(west_dx, 0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(0, west_dy, places=9)

    def test_exchange_receptor_excludes_all_weather_hall(self) -> None:
        hall = next(item for item in PROTOTYPES["exchange"]["elements"] if item["id"] == "DZ-CANOPY")
        hall_geometry = local_element_geometry(hall)
        zones = receptor_zones("exchange")
        self.assertEqual({"west_approach", "east_approach", "south_approach", "north_approach"}, set(zones))
        self.assertTrue(all(abs(geometry.area - 147.0) < 1e-9 for geometry in zones.values()))
        self.assertTrue(all(len(sample_geometry(geometry, 1.0)[0]) == 147 for geometry in zones.values()))
        for geometry in zones.values():
            self.assertLessEqual(geometry.intersection(hall_geometry).area, 1e-9)

    def test_court_receptor_areas_are_frozen(self) -> None:
        self.assertAlmostEqual(6280.0, receptor_zones("proof")["controlled_field"].area, places=6)
        origin = receptor_zones("origin")
        self.assertAlmostEqual(1292.0, origin["care_court"].area, places=6)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(840.351633, origin["forum_court"].area, places=6)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(971.644692, origin["learning_court"].area, places=6)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(441.0, route_receptor_zones("proof")["observation_route"].area, places=6)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(492.0, route_receptor_zones("origin")["public_lane"].area, delta=0.001)

    def test_no_tree_total_equals_architecture_shadow(self) -> None:
        result = evaluate_variant("proof", 0, 1, "none", self.samples, 2.0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["summer_architecture_mean_shadow_fraction"], result["summer_total_mean_shadow_fraction"], places=9)

    def test_total_shadow_is_never_below_architecture_shadow(self) -> None:
        result = evaluate_variant("origin", 0, 1, "declared", self.samples, 2.0)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(result["summer_architecture_mean_shadow_fraction"], result["summer_building_mean_shadow_fraction"])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(result["summer_total_mean_shadow_fraction"], result["summer_architecture_mean_shadow_fraction"])
        for zone in result["zone_metrics"].values():
            self.assertGreaterEqual(zone["summer_architecture_mean_shadow_fraction"], zone["summer_building_mean_shadow_fraction"])
            self.assertGreaterEqual(zone["summer_total_mean_shadow_fraction"], zone["summer_architecture_mean_shadow_fraction"])
        self.assertIn("summer_solstice_total_mean_shadow_fraction", result)
        self.assertIn("hot_season_check_total_mean_shadow_fraction", result)
        self.assertIn(result["summer_worst_interval_window_id"], {"summer_solstice", "hot_season_check"})
        self.assertIn("2026-", result["summer_worst_interval_timestamp"])
        self.assertEqual(0, result["winter_hot_season_roof_active_count"])

    def test_same_inputs_are_deterministic(self) -> None:
        first = evaluate_variant("exchange", 7.5, 0.8, "young", self.samples, 2.0)
        second = evaluate_variant("exchange", 7.5, 0.8, "young", self.samples, 2.0)
        self.assertEqual(value_sha256(first), value_sha256(second))
